Questions 58-62

DIRECTIONS: Solve each problem. On the answer sheet, write your answer in the boxes at the top
of the grid. Start on the left side of each grid. Print only one number or symbol in each box. Under
each box, fill in the circle that matches the number or symbol you wrote above.
¢ Do not fill in a circle under an unused box.
e Do not leave a box blank in the middle of an answer.
